title: Exhaust opening protection.
officialText:
Exhaust openings that terminate outdoors shall be protected with corrosion-resistant screens,
louvers or grilles. Openings in screens, louvers and grilles shall be sized not less than ¼ inch (6 mm) and not larger than ½ inch (13
mm). Openings shall be protected against local weather conditions. Outdoor openings located in exterior walls shall meet the
provisions for exterior wall opening protective in accordance with the New York City Building Code.
